column1: # Plants' batch 3 (11-04; Plants wires them on plants-batch). Own colours (plant), not tinted: the real plants' colours set them apart.

# BLOCK_LIKE per image: p3_dune brittlebush,bunchberry,lupine; p3_plum berry_bush_stage_1..3,bramble_bush_stage_3; p3_huckle lingonberry_bush_stage_1..3,crowberry_bush_stage_3; p3_tepary beans_stage_0..3; p3_birch hazel_bush_stage_3,crowberry_bush_stage_1. Horsetail keeps its approved tile.

column3: dune_grass|plant|American beachgrass on a sand dune: a dense tuft of long arching blades rising from the bottom edge, pale blue-green (#7f9a88 #98b3a0 #b3c8b5 #c9d8c6), blade tips drying to pale straw (#cfc39a), each blade 2 px wide (never 1 px), about 22 px tall, the tuft about 20 px wide
column4: dune_grass_grazed|plant|The same American beachgrass tuft grazed short: blunt cut blades 2 px wide, about 9 px tall, pale blue-green (#7f9a88 #98b3a0 #b3c8b5) with straw cut ends (#cfc39a), the same width
column5: chia|plant|Desert chia, a spring annual: a low rosette of narrow lobed grey-green leaves (#5e6f4c #7a8c5e #97a874) at the bottom, and 2-3 upright stems each carrying 2 stacked round flower whorls, ball-like clusters 5-6 px across in purple-blue (#4c4488 #6a5fb0 #8e83d0 #b2a8e6) with dark red-brown spiny bracts, about 18 px tall
column6: chia_ripe|plant|The same desert chia gone to seed: dry tan stems and leaves (#7d6845 #a48c5e #c8b384), the 2-3 stems each with 2 stacked round seed whorls in brown-grey (#5b4a38 #7a6650 #9a8670), spiky, no blue, about 18 px tall

column3: beach_plum_bush_stage_0|plant|Beach plum, stage 1 of 4: a tiny woody sprout with three small oval dark green leaves on a grey-brown stem, about 7 px tall
column4: beach_plum_bush_stage_1|plant|Beach plum, stage 2 of 4: a small rounded shrub of grey-brown twigs and small oval dark green leaves (#3e5a2a #557a36 #6f9846), about 16 px tall, 20 px wide
column5: beach_plum_bush_stage_2|plant|Beach plum, stage 3 of 4: the same shrub in blossom, covered in small white five-petal flowers (#f6f2ea #e2dccf, yellow hearts) among the leaves, about 18 px tall
column6: beach_plum_bush_stage_3|plant|Beach plum, stage 4 of 4: the same shrub with many small round dusky purple-blue plums 3 px across (#2f2c55 #48437a #6560a0, a pale dusty highlight #9a98c0), about 18 px tall

column3: huckleberry_bush_stage_0|plant|Mountain huckleberry, stage 1 of 4: a tiny sprout with four small bright green oval leaves, about 6 px tall
column4: huckleberry_bush_stage_1|plant|Mountain huckleberry, stage 2 of 4: a low upright bush of green-brown twigs and small thin oval bright green leaves (#3f6a2c #568a38 #74aa48), about 14 px tall, 18 px wide
column5: huckleberry_bush_stage_2|plant|Mountain huckleberry, stage 3 of 4: the same low bush with small pinkish urn-shaped flowers hanging under the leaves (#e8b8b8 #d0909a, 2 px), about 15 px tall
column6: huckleberry_bush_stage_3|plant|Mountain huckleberry, stage 4 of 4: the same low bush with many small round dark purple-black berries 2-3 px (#24182a #3c2844 #5a4064, a dull highlight), about 15 px tall

column3: tepary_beans_stage_0|crop|Tepary bean crop, stage 1 of 4: short sprouts, each with two small heart-shaped seed leaves, about 6 px tall, green (#4f7a2e #6e9a3c)
column4: tepary_beans_stage_1|crop|Tepary bean crop, stage 2 of 4: small low plants with narrow three-part leaves, sprawling, about 10 px tall, green (#4f7a2e #6e9a3c #8ab24c)
column5: tepary_beans_stage_2|crop|Tepary bean crop, stage 3 of 4: low sprawling bean vines with narrow three-part leaves and small white-lilac flowers (#e8e0f0 #c8b4dc), about 13 px tall
column6: tepary_beans_stage_3|crop|Tepary bean crop, stage 4 of 4 (ripe): the same low vines drying, leaves yellow-tan (#a89a4c #c4b45e), with many small flat dry pods (#b49a62 #d2bc84), about 13 px tall

column3: dwarf_birch|plant|Dwarf birch, a knee-high arctic shrub: thin red-brown twigs (#5a2e24 #7a4232 #9a5a40) spreading from the bottom, with small round toothed leaves 3-4 px (#4a7230 #64903e #82ac50), sparse enough that the twigs show, about 20 px tall, 26 px wide
